Info

CRC-16-CCITT checksum calculation and verification engine.

class scarajectory.infrastructure.communication.protocol.binary.crc16_ccitt.Crc16Ccitt[source]¶

Bases: object

Computes and validates CRC-16-CCITT (poly 0x1021, seed 0xFFFF) checksums.

It defines:

attributes:
INITIAL_SEED - Initial CRC accumulator seed (0xFFFF).
POLYNOMIAL - Generator polynomial (0x1021).
methods:
update - Updates running CRC accumulator with a single byte.
calculate - Computes 16-bit checksum over a sequence of bytes.
verify - Checks whether a byte sequence matches an expected checksum.
INITIAL_SEED: ClassVar[int] = 65535¶
POLYNOMIAL: ClassVar[int] = 4129¶
classmethod calculate(data: bytes | bytearray) → int[source]¶

Calculates CRC-16-CCITT checksum over a contiguous memory buffer.

Parameters:

data – Input raw byte sequence.

Returns:

Calculated 16-bit integer checksum.

classmethod update(crc: int, byte: int) → int[source]¶

Updates running 16-bit CRC accumulator with a single input byte.

Parameters:

  • crc – Current accumulator value.

  • byte – Input byte value (0 - 255).

Returns:

Updated 16-bit accumulator.

classmethod verify(data: bytes | bytearray, expected_crc: int) → bool[source]¶

Verifies that data computes to the given expected CRC-16 checksum.

Parameters:

  • data – Input raw byte sequence.

  • expected_crc – Expected 16-bit checksum value.

Returns:

True if checksums match, False otherwise.
